entities.summary: Marcus Dajon Maye is an American professional football safety. He has previously played in the NFL for the New York Jets, New Orleans Saints, and Miami Dolphins. He played college football for the Florida Gators. Maye is a native of Melbourne, Florida. Maye has been praised for his versatility and was selected first-team All-American by USA Today.
